subs.note: Pere Riquet. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Riquet, Missa Susanne un jour)
items.desc: Pere Riquet, Missa Susanne un jour, Kyrie, c. 1550-1600. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
